highlight.title: A Woman of Substance
highlight.description: Jessica Reynolds portrays the young Emma Harte, while Brenda Blethyn plays Emma later in life, in this sweeping saga of a Yorkshire maid's rise to a global business empire. Based on Barbara Taylor Bradford's novel, the complete first season is now available to stream.

new_arrivals.title: The Hardacres
new_arrivals.description: Claire Cooper and Liam McMahon return as Mary and Sam Hardacre. Series 2 follows the family as they adjust to life at Hardacre Hall after their rise into Yorkshire's landed society.

new_arrivals.title: The Good Ship Murder
new_arrivals.description: Shayne Ward and Catherine Tyldesley return as a former detective turned cabaret singer and his First Officer sleuthing partner. Series 3 follows Jack and Kate as they investigate murders aboard a luxury cruise ship touring the Mediterranean.

new_arrivals.title: Gone
new_arrivals.description: David Morrissey and Eve Myles star in this mystery about the disappearance of a married music teacher, whose husband becomes the focus of a tense police investigation.

new_arrivals.title: Vanity Fair
new_arrivals.description: Olivia Cooke stars as Becky Sharp in this acclaimed 2018 adaptation of Thackeray's novel, following her ambitious rise through Regency-era society against the backdrop of the Napoleonic Wars.

originals.title: Happy Valley
originals.description: Sarah Lancashire won a BAFTA for her portrayal of West Yorkshire police sergeant Catherine Cawood, among other honours. Intense, perfectly written, and utterly unmissable.

originals.title: Trigger Point
originals.description: Vicky McClure is magnetic as explosives officer Lana Washington. Each series is a taut, gripping thriller with real stakes and superb performances.

originals.title: Beyond Paradise
originals.description: A warm, character-driven spin-off of Death in Paradise, following Kris Marshall's Humphrey Goodman as he settles into life in Devon and Cornwall.

originals.title: The Other Bennet Sister
originals.description: A new drama inspired by the world of Jane Austen, focusing on Mary Bennet, the overlooked middle sister of Pride and Prejudice, as she forges her own path.
